{{Top}}
'''Rankweed''' was the pre-processed form of [[Rank (food)|rank]], a food with a gummy texture. To be called a "rankweed sucker" was a definite insult.

Pickled rankweed could be smoked, producing billowing clouds of fragrant, intoxicating blue smoke.<ref name="Death Star novel">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>
